title: The Remarried Empress Webtoon Gets TV Anime From TROYCA in 2027
content: Crunchyroll announced at New York Comic Con on Friday a television anime adaptation of HereLee and SUMPUL 's webtoon The Remarried Empress . (The webtoon is itself based on Alphatart 's original web novel.) TROYCA is animating the project for broadcast next year.
author: ANN

title: 'Kininatteru Hito ga Otoko ja Nakatta' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, First Promo
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic-con 2026 revealed additional cast, staff, and a promotional video for the television anime adaptation of Sumiko Arai 's Kininatteru Hito ga Otoko ja Nakatta ( The Guy She Was Interested in Wasn't a Guy at All ) manga on Thursday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Webtoon 'The Boxer' Gets TV Anime
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic Con 2026 announced a television anime adaptation of Ji-Hoon Jeong 's The Boxer webtoon on Thursday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a special promotional trailer.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Webtoon 'The Remarried Empress' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic-con 2026 announced a television anime adaptation of Alphatart and Sumpul 's The Remarried Princess webtoon on Thursday and revealed the main cast, staff, a fourth character visual (pictured), and special promotional video. The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Boxer TV Anime Announced With Koki Uchiyama, Kensho Ono, Tomokazu Seki and Toshiyuki Toyonaga
content: JH’s WEBTOON series The Boxer is officially getting a TV anime adaptation. A special announcement trailer was revealed alongside the main cast and production staff during the Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic Con 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: JH's The Boxer Webtoon Gets TV Anime
content: Crunchyroll announced at its panel at New York Comic Con on Thursday that JH's The Boxer webtoon is getting a television anime adaptation from new Japanese anime studio breccia and Korean animation studio Studio Jemi .
author: ANN

title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- Hits United States Theaters January 16th
content: Today at New York Comic Con, Aniplex of America and Fathom Entertainment revealed that Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- will arrive exclusively in theatres in the United States in both subtitled and English dubbed formats January 16-19, 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Berserk of Gluttony 2nd Season Anime Reveals Teaser Video, New Director, Returning Cast & Staff
content: The staff for the second season of the television anime of Ichika Isshiki and fame 's Berserk of Gluttony ( Bōshoku no Berserk: Ore Dake Level to Iu Gainen wo Toppa Suru ) light novel series revealed the teaser promotional video, and confirmed the returning cast and staff members, and new director, on Friday.
author: ANN
